chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"One does not pass through Wadi Muhassir until the sun rises."
As for the Imam, he does not exit it except after the sun has risen. He narrated that.

key_terms.وَادِيَ مُحَسِّرٍ: Wadi Muhassir, a valley near Mecca where pilgrims shorten their prayers

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on passing through Wadi Muhassir during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of Wadi Muhassir, a critical stopover on the route to Arafat, by establishing that the prohibition on passing through it applies until sunrise. It highlights the Imam’s (Imam al-Sadiq) adherence to this timing, reinforcing the legal precedent for pilgrims to delay their exit from the valley to avoid the heat and ensure proper ritual timing. This ruling underscores the precision with which Shia jurisprudence integrates environmental factors into the performance of Hajj rituals.
